text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Beats me! I was out running, saw a sandlot 
baseball game by the riverbank, jumped in 
for a bit, and smashed a home run!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So you didn't have it... Tsk. Guess that 
die is out on the highway by now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Never thought it'd land right in the bed 
of a long-haul truck. You chucked that 
thing way too hard, man.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, maybe I tensed up a bit too 
much. Still... it'd be easy to give up 
here, but I'm not one to back down once 
I've accepted a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth! You were so itching 
to go to Koshien... dammit!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...No, the trip I wanted to take was a 
high-stakes tour where the roll of a die 
decides our destination, but—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, no... things are getting interesting 
now, aren't they?! My destination was 
always left to the roll of the dice 
anyway... In that case, I'll chase that 
truck bed to the ends of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I understand... You're going, right? To 
America. It'd be a waste not to put that 
shoulder of yours to good use, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
America or France, doesn't matter. If 
there are dice rolling, then count me 
in...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's what it means— to bet on your own 
future!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kuuuh! That's the Nakayama I know! Just 
you wait, Manager Golshi's gonna go scout 
8 more people who can play baseball!
